sampling: Exclude all 200 candidates from natural-repetition-v1, then order the remaining HotpotQA validation IDs by SHA256([seed,id]); first 64 candidates, first 8 passing complete-context tokenizer eligibility. No label or outcome selection. Reuses the same label-free eight questions as failed citation-interface-001: one HTTP 400, zero model completions, no scientific outcomes available before v2.
limits: Prospective interface diagnostic, not DICE method validation or a publishable novelty claim.
Retains original messages/generic JSON payload; explicit prompt adds ID syntax and empty-answer example together.
Actual unchanged vLLM 0.8.3 V1 engine uses xgrammar. Request must exactly match its backend; no fallback selected.
Guided grammar enforces two required fields, visible bare canonical IDs, zero to eight citations. Allows both key orders and JSON whitespace, but canonical unescaped key/ID spellings only.
Visible-ID membership does not establish evidential support. Answer UTF-8 byte count and factual correctness remain separate checks.
Finite CPU fixtures exercise installed V1 admission/compiler and tokenizer, not a proof of all token paths or full live request admission.
Invalid complete outputs score zero; pending/failed calls block full scoring. No repair, retries, truncation, sample change, or effect-based stopping.
Eight questions are independent units, not 64 calls; bootstrap intervals descriptive and unadjusted.
Sampling is fresh from the prior 200-question frame, not demonstrably unseen during model pretraining.
Failed v1 preserved separately; no pooling with earlier natural-repetition results.

interface_readiness.interpretation: Engineering threshold only; does not establish answer quality, method efficacy, or trigger an automatic new batch.
